text:
raj-sales: quick ask — PartnerGreen onboarding: they want a one-off onboarding credit to cover migration work. asking for $45,000 credit applied to first invoice, customer to prepay for 3 months of dedicated capacity, invoice on Net60. can finance + legal sign off?
maya-fin: curious — what's the ARR/expected runrate after onboarding? need to check unit economics before greenlight. also is this refundable? :thinking: 
raj-sales: good q — expected committed spend after onboarding ~ $28k/month for 12 months. credit is to offset their integration costs; not refundable.
sophie-dealdesk: recommend structured exception: 1) one-off credit applied to invoice #1 only, 2) credits capped to $45k, 3) require prepay confirmation and PO before we apply. can we add a clawback if they churn in 60 days?
maya-fin: we usually ask for a 6-month clawback on big credits, but since they're prepaying 3 months maybe 3-month clawback is ok. need margin calc. can someone drop the numbers?
pricing-bot: Auto-calc: projected gross margin with credit = 31% (vs target 40%). Projected payback = 5.4 months. Link: https://redwood.internal/finance/credits/DDR-4721
oliver-cfo: hold — 31% margin seems low for strategic partner unless there are strategic reasons (channel/resell, referenceable). sales, pls enumerate strategic benefits in 1 line.
raj-sales: benefit: channel reach into EDU sector, 3 pilot customers committed, potential reseller agreement in Q3. also higher likelihood of contract expansion.
lina-legal: will need SOW clause for credit application and explicit churn clawback term. I'll draft an amendment. can finance confirm language needed for accounting?
maya-fin: accounting note: treat as contra-revenue applied to invoice. need GL code and cost center. Also need invoice note: "Onboarding credit applied per Deal Desk approval DD-4721."
sophie-dealdesk: to move forward — can we get final approval from finance + legal + cfo? I'll put proposed exception in Deal Desk queue.
oliver-cfo: approve conditional on 3-month clawback and signed reseller LOI within 90 days. if LOI not received, credit to be amortized and clawback triggered.
raj-sales: understood. will get LOI and PO. thx all. :thumbsup:
pricing-bot: Deal Desk ticket DD-4721 updated: status -> pending legal docs. Assigned: sophie-dealdesk, lina-legal, maya-fin.
maya-fin: I'll schedule a quick review tomorrow 10:30 to confirm GL mapping and final numbers.
lina-legal: draft finished, dropping in the ticket now.
sophie-dealdesk: moving to "approved-provisionally" per CFO conditions. will post final note when LOI arrives.
